signal-pink.$description: Signal Pink — Gradient origin — Instagram brand gradient start point, the chromatic anchor in the system

plasma-magenta.$description: Plasma Magenta — Gradient midpoint — bridges hot pink into ultraviolet, used in the brand gradient only

ultraviolet.$description: Ultraviolet — Gradient terminus — deep violet end of the Instagram brand gradient, the cool counterweight

hot-magenta.$description: Hot Magenta — Full-bleed color panel — left half of the hero split, the loudest single surface in the system

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Full-bleed accent band — right half of the hero split and secondary color sections, softens the magenta

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, button borders, list dividers, nav borders — the primary near-black for all text and hairline rules

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Specimen letterforms, Instagram camera icon outlines, high-contrast graphic moments — flat black with no warmth

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Content canvas, text on color panels, button text, input backgrounds — the neutral ground that lets color panels pop

hairline-gray.$description: Hairline Gray — Subtle button borders and disabled-state rules

link-indigo.$description: Link Indigo — Violet accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

instagram-sans.$description: The brand's custom geometric sans. Used for everything from 12px captions to 389px specimen hero letterforms. Single weight 400 across the entire scale — the typeface achieves personality through geometry and tight negative tracking rather than weight contrast. Letter-spacing tightens as size grows: -0.02em at body, -0.03em at 32–46px, -0.035em at 62px and above.

instagram-sans-headline.$description: Distinct variant for the 468px mega-specimen display — looser tracking (-0.006em) than the base family because at 468px the tight tracking would close letter apertures. Used only for the largest type specimen on the page.

helvetica.$description: System fallback appearing at 12px (likely OS-rendered small text) and 224px (possible secondary specimen). Treat as fallback only — Instagram Sans is the intended primary at all sizes.
